task.description:
TC-TM-UI-05 hangs because it calls createTestTenant() which triggers the onboarding saga — and the saga never transitions from pending to completed. This is the same root cause that was just fixed for TC-TM-UI-04.

Background:
- TC-TM-UI-04 was fixed by navigating via the tenant list page (click edit on existing tenant) instead of creating a fixture tenant.
- TC-TM-UI-05 still uses createTestTenant() because it needs to modify and save a tenant.
- The backend onboarding saga (runSagaBackground) is the root cause — it never completes, so waitForOnboardingTerminalState times out.

Fix approach — use an existing tenant instead of creating one:
1. Navigate to the tenant list, click edit on an existing tenant (like TC-TM-UI-04 does now)
2. Read the current display_name
3. Edit the display_name to a new value
4. Save (PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug)
5. Verify navigation back to /admin/tenants
6. Optional: navigate back to edit and restore the original display_name

This avoids createTestTenant() entirely and tests the same edit functionality.

Fix constraint: 1 file (web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts).

Also: after fixing TC-TM-UI-05, check if TC-TM-UI-06 and TC-TM-UI-07 also use createTestTenant(). If so, fix those too (same approach — use existing tenant or verify they don't need created fixtures).

Return PASS when all remaining TM E2E tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: TC-TM-UI-06 passes if it was failing
TC-TM-UI-07 passes if it was failing

result.summary: Fixed Category A (test error — test used createTestTenant which hangs due to onboarding saga never completing) in tenants.e2e.spec.ts: rewrote TC-TM-UI-05 to use an existing tenant from the list page instead of creating a fixture tenant. TC-TM-UI-06 and TC-TM-UI-07 did not use createTestTenant and were already fine.
